author: reactive-end
summary: New Tier 0 rule no-swallowed-errors. It flags handlers that drop an error silently: an empty or comment-only catch in TS/JS/PHP/Kotlin/Dart, `.catch(() => {})` in TS/JS, `except ...: pass` or `...` in Python, and an `Err(_) => {}` or `()` match arm in Rust. Allowed only via structured anvil-allow. Calibrated with slop benchmark cases plus clean counter-cases (rethrow, logging, a handled fallback).
